final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT g.ID, g.avg_ana AS average_ANA, g.avg_ana - m.mean_avg AS excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE g.avg_ana > m.mean_avg ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
